clusters.headline: Sonia Gandhi Memoir Belonging Sparks Political And Personal Debate
aiSummaryBullets: Sonia Gandhi's newly released memoir, Belonging, addresses personal tragedies, including the loss of a child and political reflections.
The book has triggered political controversy, with the BJP disputing the author's account of the 1984 anti-Sikh massacre.

clusters.headline: Hardik Pandya Moves To Punjab Kings In Trade With Mumbai Indians
aiSummaryBullets: Hardik Pandya has concluded his second tenure with the Mumbai Indians after three seasons.
The Punjab Kings acquired Pandya in a trade deal with the Mumbai franchise.

clusters.headline: Kolkata-Sairang Express Derails Near Digaru Railway Station Assam
aiSummaryBullets: Several coaches and the engine of the Kolkata-Sairang Express derailed at Digaru station in Assam.
Conflicting reports exist regarding casualties, with some sources citing no injuries and others noting multiple injured passengers.

clusters.headline: Indian Cities Report Severe Air Pollution Following Deepavali
aiSummaryBullets: Air quality in New Delhi reached record lows following Deepavali, with thick smog reported across the capital.
The Supreme Court of India highlighted vehicular emissions as a persistent pollution factor alongside firework activity.

clusters.headline: 'Why are we becoming Vishwaguru in air pollution?' Congress questions PM Modi
aiSummaryBullets: Times of India reports: 'Why are we becoming Vishwaguru in air pollution?' Congress questions PM Modi
The Hindu reports: 'Notebandi' devastated economy, 'votebandi' destroying polity: Congress slams PM Modi

clusters.headline: India And Global Communities Celebrate The Annual Diwali Festival
aiSummaryBullets: Diwali festivities across India include prayer services, traditional rangoli patterns, fireworks, and the sharing of sweets.
Major celebrations were held in Ayodhya, involving drone displays, light shows, and theatrical performances based on the Hindu epic Ramayana.

clusters.headline: Presidential Bodyguard Sustains Gunshot Injury During Uttar Pradesh Visit
aiSummaryBullets: A 28-year-old soldier assigned to the President’s Bodyguard sustained a gunshot wound to the head while visiting his home village in Baghpat, Uttar Pradesh.
Local reports indicate the shooting occurred on Diwali night following a confrontation with neighbors stemming from an alleged long-standing rivalry.

clusters.headline: Diverse Developments Impact State Of Tamil Nadu In India Recently
aiSummaryBullets: Law enforcement officials in Tamil Nadu conducted a statewide operation resulting in 443 arrests of habitual offenders.
Three workers died following an incident at a facility manufacturing iPhone components operated by the Tata Group.

clusters.headline: Qantas Announces Plans To Outsource Eight Hundred Fifty Local Jobs
aiSummaryBullets: Qantas intends to outsource 850 corporate roles to the consultancy firm Accenture.
The airline stated that a majority of these positions will be relocated to India.

clusters.headline: CISCE Releases 2027 Examination Timetables For Class 10 And 12
aiSummaryBullets: The Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE) released official timetables for the 2027 board sessions.
ISC Class 12 examinations are scheduled to take place between February 9 and April 8, 2027.
